# TikTok for Business

> > TikTok for Business provides advertising solutions, creative tools, and marketing resources for brands to reach audiences through short-form video content on the TikTok platform.

TikTok for Business offers comprehensive marketing solutions including Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, Creative Center, and TikTok Shop for brands to execute campaigns. The platform features case studies demonstrating success across beauty, food delivery, gaming, automotive, and financial services sectors using Branded Hashtag Challenges, app event optimization, and full-funnel marketing strategies.

## Key Topics

- TikTok Ads Manager
- Branded Hashtag Challenge
- Creator Marketplace
- Creative Center
- TikTok Shop
- Business Center
- Brand advertising
- Social media marketing
- Influencer marketing
- User-generated content (UGC)
- App event optimization
- Full-funnel marketing
- Brand awareness campaigns
- E-commerce traffic
- Customer acquisition

- [Bioré | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/bior%C3%A9-218): Bioré skincare holiday season marketing campaign on TikTok
